articles.title: Bitcoin shrugs off AI selloff but high-stakes Fed meeting could determine what's next
articles.description: BTC held near $65,000 even as Nvidia and AI stocks fell sharply. This week's Fed decision could determine whether bitcoin finally breaks higher or revisits June's lows, analysts said.

articles.title: Bitmine keeps buying Ether as ETH outperforms Bitcoin
articles.description: The company added nearly 10,000 ETH over the past week, bringing its holdings to 5.79 million Ether, about 85% of which is staked through its validator operations.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Securitize Capital becomes SEC-registered investment adviser
articles.description: The registration expands Securitize’s regulated platform for tokenized assets, adding investment advisory services to its institutional offering.

articles.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
articles.description: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.

articles.title: Apple sued after alleged App Store crypto scam cost users $1.8M
articles.description: Apple is facing a lawsuit from three users who say they collectively lost more than $1.8 million after downloading a fraudulent crypto wallet from the App Store, challenging the company’s longstanding claims that its app review process keeps users safe from scams.

articles.title: Amazon’s new satellite network for mobile phones could turn up the heat on SpaceX
articles.description: Amazon is expanding its plans for providing satellite connectivity to mobile phones.

articles.title: Crypto’s favorite $90 trillion trading product is coming to Wall Street, but big banks are taking it slow
articles.description: Regulated perpetual futures are officially landing in the U.S., but while agile trading firms and crypto exchanges race to capture massive retail demand, traditional Wall Street banks are holding back until liquidity, rules, and infrastructure mature.

articles.title: Antares raises $470M to build nuclear reactors for the US military
articles.description: Antares has raised $470 million to build small modular reactors — 100 kW to 1 MW — for U.S. Air Force bases.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
articles.description: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.

articles.title: Digital asset trading platform Uphold cuts 17% of global headcount as crypto winter bites
articles.description: The crypto trading platform said the layoffs reflect a strategic shift toward its fast-growing enterprise business.

articles.title: Threads users can now chat with Meta AI in their DMs
articles.description: Meta on Monday said it is rolling out its Meta AI chatbot within Threads' DMs, giving users a way to chat with the AI assistant.

articles.title: Tether’s XAUt gold token receives Shariah certification to expand Islamic finance access
articles.description: The certification could expand access to Tether’s gold-backed token among Islamic financial institutions and investors seeking Shariah-compliant exposure to physical gold.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business
articles.description: The deal brings wallet technology to Payward’s enterprise platform, potentially reducing the number of infrastructure providers businesses need to integrate with.

articles.title: Google’s AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.description: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.

articles.title: Power up your AI infrastructure! A first look at the Smart Systems Stage agenda at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Smart Systems Stage will be where energy, infrastructure, and technology collide, covering everything from fusion breakthroughs to the grid strain AI is putting on the entire economy.

articles.title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
articles.description: After two years in stealth, Safe Superintelligence has announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.

articles.title: What are perps, anyway? Everything you need to know about crypto’s hottest trading instrument
articles.description: Perps, which launched on BitMEX in 2016, have become one of the most traded financial products in the world.

articles.title: Bitcoin price eyes $66K as US stocks rise on Iran-strike pause
articles.description: Bitcoin copied US stocks as relief over end of US-Iran strikes spread to risk assets at the start of the US trading session.

articles.title: Fanatics buys regulated exchange in bid to grow prediction markets business
articles.description: The deal gives Fanatics control of its own prediction market infrastructure as event-based trading gains traction across sports, finance and crypto.
